Little by little, things began to change. Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Tom usually spends the weekend reading at the gym. What's more, everyone did their bit for the clean-up.

Tom thanked Jack for the honest advice. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Tom often share different ideas about the spring market. The children showed their love with drawings.

The dragon boat river has become an important part of daily life. At first, Tom found it difficult to keep the habit. The spring market looked quieter than usual that evening. The granddaughter helps her grandma cook.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Tom keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Dinner is ready.
Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. Tom's dream job is to be a teacher.
